sources.title: INTEGREX i-500
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: DMG MORI DMU 五軸加工平台
related.titleEn: DMG MORI DMU five-axis machining platform
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付基準鏈、變異數預算與製程整合方案。；教學 σ 門檻 0.020 mm 下三次裝夾失敗，去除中間裝夾通過；系統偏差另查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a datum chain, variance budget and process-integration proposal.; At a teaching σ limit of 0.020 mm, three setups fail and removing the middle one passes; check bias separately.
related.difference: 用弦長模型估計旋轉中心偏置在不同轉角造成的工具點誤差。
related.differenceEn: Use a chord model to estimate tool-point error caused by rotary-center offset.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 獨立裝夾隨機誤差以 RSS 合成；共用基準的相關誤差必須另外處理。；教學三次裝夾標準差 0.010、0.020、0.015 mm。；σ=sqrt(0.010²+0.020²+0.015²)=0.026926 mm。
中心偏置 r 在轉角 θ 下造成差異弦長 e=2r sin(θ/2)。；教學偏置 r=0.020 mm，轉角 θ=90°。；e=2×0.020×sin45°=0.028284 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Independent setup errors combine by RSS; correlated common-datum errors need separate treatment.; Teaching setup standard deviations are 0.010, 0.020 and 0.015 mm.; σ=sqrt(0.010²+0.020²+0.015²)=0.026926 mm.
A center offset r creates a differential chord e=2r sin(θ/2) over rotation θ.; Teaching offset r=0.020 mm and rotation θ=90°.; e=2×0.020×sin45°=0.028284 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工具機誤差預算
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付基準鏈、變異數預算與製程整合方案。；教學 σ 門檻 0.020 mm 下三次裝夾失敗，去除中間裝夾通過；系統偏差另查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a datum chain, variance budget and process-integration proposal.; At a teaching σ limit of 0.020 mm, three setups fail and removing the middle one passes; check bias separately.
related.difference: 比較最壞相加與獨立隨機 RSS，正確選擇驗收依據。
related.differenceEn: Compare worst-case addition with independent-random RSS and choose the proper acceptance basis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 獨立裝夾隨機誤差以 RSS 合成；共用基準的相關誤差必須另外處理。；教學三次裝夾標準差 0.010、0.020、0.015 mm。；σ=sqrt(0.010²+0.020²+0.015²)=0.026926 mm。
上界最壞和 B=Σbi；獨立零均值標準差 σ=sqrt(Σσi²)，兩者意義不同。；教學三個誤差量為 10、8、5 μm，分別以界限與標準差兩種假設計算。；最壞和=23 μm；若為獨立標準差，RSS=sqrt(100+64+25)=13.7477 μm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Independent setup errors combine by RSS; correlated common-datum errors need separate treatment.; Teaching setup standard deviations are 0.010, 0.020 and 0.015 mm.; σ=sqrt(0.010²+0.020²+0.015²)=0.026926 mm.

Worst-case bound B=Σbi differs from independent zero-mean σ=sqrt(Σσi²).; Teaching terms are 10, 8 and 5 μm, considered under two separate assumptions: bounds or standard deviations.; Worst-case sum=23 μm; if independent standard deviations, RSS=sqrt(189)=13.7477 μm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
